mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in 2 months indicate broad demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO below 105.0) reduce production capacity and compress profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in residential construction (HOUST) signals housing market strength that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has increased for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL above 295.0) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises above 295.0 in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate increases (>0.2pp) and employment declines (>0.5%) in 3 months signal severe labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending booms (RSAFS above 680,000) drive retail sales growth and corporate revenue, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 680,000.
